# The OPSEC Rave Wave (with Imani Thompson)
This week, I’m thrilled to be joined by Imani Thompson. Imani is a digital security trainer and host of a series of events called Cache Me Outside, where she and partner orgs help people understand their personal security, divest from big tech platforms, and learn how to stay safe online. She recently hosted a “de-Googling” party and [a self-doxxing rave](https://www.404media.co/trans-rights-privacy-online-cybersecurity-workshop-deadname-not-found/).
We get into how platforms have tried to make surveillance cute, why that damn Duolingo owl emotionally manipulates you, and why learning about privacy best practices when surrounded by community works.
Follow [Imani on Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/y2kbug.zip?ref=404media.co)
[A 'Self-Doxing' Rave Helps Trans People Stay Safe Online](https://www.404media.co/trans-rights-privacy-online-cybersecurity-workshop-deadname-not-found/)
[Now you can break up with big tech at a bar: ‘cybersecurity disguised as a party’](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/apr/16/big-tech-breakup-parties?ref=404media.co)
[Fix It With Piggy](https://fixitwithpiggy.org/?ref=404media.co)

# OPSEC 銳舞浪潮（Imani Thompson 專訪）
本週，我很高興邀請到 Imani Thompson。Imani 是一位數位安全培訓講師，也是 Cache Me Outside 系列活動的主持人；在這些活動中，她與合作組織協助大家理解自己的個人資安、降低對大型科技平台的依賴，並學習如何在網路上保護自己。她最近主辦了一場「去 Google 化」派對，以及[一場自我肉搜銳舞派對](https://www.404media.co/trans-rights-privacy-online-cybersecurity-workshop-deadname-not-found/)。
我們聊到平台如何試圖把監控包裝得很可愛、那隻該死的 Duolingo 貓頭鷹為什麼會情緒勒索你，以及為什麼在社群陪伴下學習隱私保護的最佳實務會有效。
追蹤 [Imani 的 Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/y2kbug.zip?ref=404media.co)
[一場「自我肉搜」銳舞派對，幫助跨性別者在網路上保護自己](https://www.404media.co/trans-rights-privacy-online-cybersecurity-workshop-deadname-not-found/)
[現在你可以在酒吧和大型科技公司分手：「偽裝成派對的網路安全」](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/apr/16/big-tech-breakup-parties?ref=404media.co)
